justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/Connection.java and src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/HttpConnection.java, plus src/test/java/org/jsoup/helper/HttpConnectionTest.java. `Connection.KeyVal` is defined as a single key/value tuple API, and `HttpConnection.KeyVal` is a small nested implementation with 4 fields (key, value, stream, contentType) and only simple factories/getters/setters plus `hasInputStream()` and `toString()`. Its behavior stays cohesive around form-data/file-upload metadata, with no evidence of multiple unrelated responsibilities or a need to split it into smaller abstractions.
